title: Giggy Recognizer Options
description: Giggy live STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'giggy'. Giggy ends each utterance after 650 ms of silence (energy-based, not semantic) and returns cumulative interim results then one final per utterance; there are no confidence scores (transcripts are reported with confidence 1.0). Giggy rejects recognition hints, so hints are not sent. Set the recognizer language to a supported locale (e.g. en-US, es-ES, vi-VN), or to 'any' for automatic language detection.

apiKey.description: Giggy API key. Overrides the key configured in jambonz.

giggySttUri.description: Custom host to connect to instead of api.giggy.ai (e.g. a proxy).

giggySttUseTls.description: Use TLS when connecting to a custom host. Default true.
